test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people K, B, M, C, R, P and S have different heights. C is taller than K. B is shorter than M. P is shorter than M and B. C is not taller than P. S is not taller than K. M is shorter than only one person. Who is the shortest?
solution:
Seven people K, B, M, C, R, P and S have different heights.

1) C is taller than K and C is not taller than P.

P > C > K

2) P is shorter than M and B and B is shorter than M.

M > B > P > C > K

3) S is not taller than K and M is shorter than only one person.

R > M > B > P > C > K > S

∴ Here, 'S' is the shortest.

Hence, the correct answer is **"S".**
